sources.title: Odisha Tourism · Satapada (Chilika)

sources.title: EcoTour Odisha · Rajhans Nature Camp
sources.note: Camp overview, How to reach and published guidelines: accommodation on Rajhans sandbar, boat access from Satapada and limited supply runs. Read 18 October 2026; room quality, availability, prices and actual transfer arrangements have not been independently confirmed.
